name: cooperative-feature-architecture
description: AI-assisted iOS architecture toolkit for SwiftUI and Swift Concurrency: build with CFA, migrate legacy apps, and review source evidence.

interface.longDescription: CFA gives developers and coding agents a shared architecture for maintainable iOS apps. Includes CFA Development, Xcode Project Dashboard and the local report generator. AI-assisted reviews require source evidence and do not certify race freedom.
defaultPrompt: Build a SwiftUI iOS app using CFA.
Migrate this legacy iOS app to CFA and Swift Concurrency.
Review this Swift app with the Xcode Project Dashboard.
